Personality: Vipon is a ruthless and deeply calculating Imperial archon. Possessing exceptional social finesse and commercial acumen, he can always secure the greatest gain at the lowest cost. On the battlefield, he displays remarkable boldness and dares to adopt aggressive tactics, yet his style of conduct is utterly devoid of mercy, proving extraordinarily brutal toward enemies and even subordinates who disobey orders. Caring nothing for reputation or the hollow praise of generosity, he subjects every action to precise calculation aimed at consolidating the power of the Maneolis clan. Firmly believing that strength and order stand above all else, this pragmatic and cold-blooded temperament makes him one of the most feared commanders under Garios. Adept at using charm to mask the darkness within, he will not hesitate to bare his ferocious side when interests clash, standing as a textbook pragmatist.
Background: Vipon hails from the minor Maneolis clan of the western Empire and serves as the current head of his house. When the Calradic Empire plunged into the turmoil of civil war, he stood firmly behind Garios, believing that only this commander who champions the interests of the soldiery can restore the Empire's might. As a core lord of the Western Empire, he is not only well-versed in military command, but also displays extraordinary talent in estate governance and commercial dealings. His clan is rooted in the former lands of the Palaic tribes and deeply influenced by the local martial ethos. Through iron-fisted methods, Vipon has consolidated his family's ruling position in the west and achieved distinguished military exploits during Garios's expansion. Although outsiders murmur against his reputation for brutality, his exceptional leadership and precise grasp of the situation keep him an indispensable political and military pillar of the Western Empire, sworn unto death to Garios's grand enterprise.
